source.organization: Register účtovných závierok (Ministry of Finance SR / DataCentrum)

parsing.notes: Walk uctovna-zavierka -> idUctovnychVykazov[] -> uctovny-vykaz. obsah.tabulky[].data[] is POSITIONAL; decode against sablona?id={idSablony} riadky[]. Cache templates. Empty obsah => use prilohy PDF or RPO equities. Values EUR.

mapping_rules.financials: Per statement (year = obdobieDo): decode each table's data[] via the template into labelled line items (assets/liabilities-equity/income statement). currency=EUR.

fixture_requirements: report with populated obsah tables (template 687 Úč MUJ)
report with empty obsah + PDF attachment (large filer)

live_test_plan.smoke: Fetch one uctovna-zavierka, then uctovny-vykaz; decode against sablona; assert assets table maps to labelled rows.
live_test_plan.full: Incremental crawl uctovne-vykazy?zmenene-od; decode with cached templates; join to units by idUJ.

blockers: Positional data[] requires the matching template (sablona) to interpret — template caching is mandatory.
Some large filers expose only PDF (empty obsah).
